steps.command: set -e; ovs-vsctl set port s1-eth1 vlan_mode=access tag=10; ovs-vsctl set port s1-eth2 vlan_mode=access tag=20; ovs-vsctl set port s1-eth3 vlan_mode=access tag=30; ovs-vsctl set port s1-eth4 vlan_mode=trunk trunks=10,20,30

set -e; ovs-vsctl set port s2-eth1 vlan_mode=access tag=10; ovs-vsctl set port s2-eth2 vlan_mode=access tag=20; ovs-vsctl set port s2-eth3 vlan_mode=access tag=30; ovs-vsctl set port s2-eth4 vlan_mode=trunk trunks=10,20,30; ovs-vsctl set port s2-eth5 vlan_mode=trunk trunks=10,20,30

set -e; ovs-vsctl set port s3-eth1 vlan_mode=access tag=10; ovs-vsctl set port s3-eth2 vlan_mode=access tag=20; ovs-vsctl set port s3-eth3 vlan_mode=access tag=30; ovs-vsctl set port s3-eth4 vlan_mode=trunk trunks=10,20,30
set -e; ip addr flush dev a1-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.1/24 dev a1-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.11/32 dev a1-eth0; ip link set a1-eth0 up
set -e; ip addr flush dev a2-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.2/24 dev a2-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.12/32 dev a2-eth0; ip link set a2-eth0 up
set -e; ip addr flush dev a3-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.3/24 dev a3-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.13/32 dev a3-eth0; ip link set a3-eth0 up
set -e; ip addr flush dev b1-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.1/24 dev b1-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.21/32 dev b1-eth0; ip link set b1-eth0 up
set -e; ip addr flush dev b2-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.2/24 dev b2-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.22/32 dev b2-eth0; ip link set b2-eth0 up
set -e; ip addr flush dev b3-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.3/24 dev b3-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.23/32 dev b3-eth0; ip link set b3-eth0 up
set -e; ip addr flush dev c1-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.1/24 dev c1-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.31/32 dev c1-eth0; ip link set c1-eth0 up
set -e; ip addr flush dev c2-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.2/24 dev c2-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.32/32 dev c2-eth0; ip link set c2-eth0 up
set -e; ip addr flush dev c3-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.3/24 dev c3-eth0; ip addr add 10.20.0.33/32 dev c3-eth0; ip link set c3-eth0 up

for ip in 10.20.0.21 10.20.0.22 10.20.0.23 10.20.0.31 10.20.0.32 10.20.0.33; do ping -c 1 -W 2 $ip; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then echo "tenant isolation check failed: $ip (ping exit $rc)" >&2; exit 1; fi; done

for ip in 10.20.0.11 10.20.0.12 10.20.0.13 10.20.0.31 10.20.0.32 10.20.0.33; do ping -c 1 -W 2 $ip; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then echo "tenant isolation check failed: $ip (ping exit $rc)" >&2; exit 1; fi; done

for ip in 10.20.0.11 10.20.0.12 10.20.0.13 10.20.0.21 10.20.0.22 10.20.0.23; do ping -c 1 -W 2 $ip; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then echo "tenant isolation check failed: $ip (ping exit $rc)" >&2; exit 1; fi; done
